data.one_liner: Encode, decode, and pick colors using the OKLCH color space in Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: It converts colors between RGB and the OKLCH color space, supports OKLABColor, color mixing, and provides an OKLCH-based color picker widget.
use_when: You want to use the OKLCH color space for modern color palettes.
You need a color picker based on OKLCH.
avoid_when: You require exact color matching with the official lch.oklch.com reference site.
You only need standard Material color pickers.
strengths: Provides OKLCH to RGB and RGB to OKLCH conversions.
Includes a built-in OKLCH color picker widget.
weaknesses: Does not currently give the exact same results as the official website reference.

alternatives.name: flutter_colorpicker
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a more established, traditional color picker widget.

alternatives.name: flex_color_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need an extensive color picker with many built-in themes and color spaces.
